scripts.dev: npm run build -w @specsentry/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client "npm run dev -w @specsentry/shared" "npm run dev -w @specsentry/server" "npm run dev -w @specsentry/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @specsentry/shared && npm run build -w @specsentry/server && npm run build -w @specsentry/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @specsentry/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @specsentry/shared && npm run test -w @specsentry/server && npm run test -w @specsentry/client
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @specsentry/shared && npm run test:integration -w @specsentry/server
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @specsentry/shared && npm run db:seed -w @specsentry/server
scripts.db:seed:reviewer: npm run build -w @specsentry/shared && npm run db:seed:reviewer -w @specsentry/server
